\subsection{Multilayer Dynamics}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:multilayer-dynamics}}\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics::doc}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleemphasis{Simulating epidemic spread, diffusion, and other dynamical processes on multilayer networks.}

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{note}{🔬 DSL for Dynamics}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Run dynamics simulations declaratively with the DSL:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dynamics}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{D}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{SIS}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Define and run SIS simulation}
\PYG{n}{sim} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{D}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{process}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{SIS}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{beta}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.3}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{mu}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.1}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{initial}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{infected}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.05}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{steps}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{100}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{measure}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{prevalence}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{seed}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{42}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{sim}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{run}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Peak prevalence: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{data}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{prevalence}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{max}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.2\PYGZpc{}}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
See {\hyperref[\detokenize{user_guide/dsl::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{SQL\sphinxhyphen{}like DSL for Multilayer Networks}}}} for complete dynamics DSL documentation!
\end{sphinxadmonition}


\bigskip\hrule\bigskip


\sphinxAtStartPar
Many real\sphinxhyphen{}world phenomena involve \sphinxstylestrong{processes that evolve over time} on network structures. Epidemics spread through contact networks. Information diffuses through social media. Ideas propagate through collaboration networks. \sphinxstylestrong{Multilayer dynamics} capture how these processes unfold when nodes interact through multiple, simultaneous channels.

\sphinxAtStartPar
This chapter shows you how to:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Simulate \sphinxstylestrong{epidemic dynamics} (SIR, SIS) on multilayer networks

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Run \sphinxstylestrong{random walks} and analyze exploration patterns

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Configure \sphinxstylestrong{initial conditions} and \sphinxstylestrong{parameters}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Extract and visualize \sphinxstylestrong{simulation results}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Understand how \sphinxstylestrong{layer structure affects dynamics}

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
py3plex provides a clean, object\sphinxhyphen{}oriented API for dynamics that integrates seamlessly with the rest of the library.


\bigskip\hrule\bigskip



\subsubsection{Overview of Dynamics Models}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:overview-of-dynamics-models}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
py3plex supports three main classes of dynamics:

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Epidemic Models}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{SIR (Susceptible\sphinxhyphen{}Infected\sphinxhyphen{}Recovered)} — Models diseases with lasting immunity (measles, chickenpox)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{SIS (Susceptible\sphinxhyphen{}Infected\sphinxhyphen{}Susceptible)} — Models diseases without immunity (common cold, computer viruses)

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Diffusion Processes}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Random Walk} — Models exploration, search, and diffusion on networks

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
All models support:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
✅ \sphinxstylestrong{Multilayer networks} — Different interaction contexts (physical, digital, etc.)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
✅ \sphinxstylestrong{Reproducible simulations} — Seeded random number generation

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
✅ \sphinxstylestrong{Rich output measures} — Prevalence, state counts, trajectories

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
✅ \sphinxstylestrong{Clean API} — Object\sphinxhyphen{}oriented design aligned with best practices

\end{itemize}


\bigskip\hrule\bigskip



\subsubsection{SIR Epidemic Dynamics}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:sir-epidemic-dynamics}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The \sphinxstylestrong{SIR model} simulates epidemic spread where infected individuals recover with lasting immunity. This is appropriate for many infectious diseases and for modeling information spread where people don’t “forget” what they’ve learned.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{States:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{S (Susceptible)} — Not infected, can become infected

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{I (Infected)} — Currently infected, can transmit to susceptibles

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{R (Recovered)} — Recovered with immunity, cannot be re\sphinxhyphen{}infected

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Parameters:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{beta}} (β) — Transmission rate (probability per contact per time step)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{gamma}} (γ) — Recovery rate (probability of recovery per time step)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{initial\_infected}} — Fraction or number of initially infected nodes

\end{itemize}


\paragraph{Basic Example}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:basic-example}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dynamics}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{SIRDynamics}
\PYG{k+kn}{import}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{networkx}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k}{as}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{nx}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create a network}
\PYG{n}{G} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{nx}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{karate\PYGZus{}club\PYGZus{}graph}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create SIR dynamics}
\PYG{n}{sir} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{SIRDynamics}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{G}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{beta}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.3}\PYG{p}{,}              \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Infection probability}
    \PYG{n}{gamma}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.1}\PYG{p}{,}             \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Recovery probability}
    \PYG{n}{initial\PYGZus{}infected}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.1}   \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} 10\PYGZpc{} initially infected}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Set seed for reproducibility}
\PYG{n}{sir}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{set\PYGZus{}seed}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{42}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Run simulation}
\PYG{n}{results} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{sir}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{run}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{steps}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{100}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Extract measures}
\PYG{n}{prevalence} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{results}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}measure}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{prevalence}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{state\PYGZus{}counts} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{results}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}measure}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{state\PYGZus{}counts}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Peak prevalence: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{prevalence}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{max}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.2\PYGZpc{}}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Final recovered: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{state\PYGZus{}counts}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{R}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Example Output:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
Peak prevalence: 35.29\PYGZpc{}
Final recovered: 30
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
The epidemic infects about 88\% of the network before dying out naturally.


\paragraph{Multilayer SIR Example}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:multilayer-sir-example}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
On multilayer networks, infection can spread through different interaction contexts:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{multinet}
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dynamics}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{SIRDynamics}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create two\PYGZhy{}layer network}
\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{directed}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Add nodes to two layers}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{i} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n+nb}{range}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{20}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}
        \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{i}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{physical}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{i}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{digital}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}
    \PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Physical layer: local ring connections}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{i} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n+nb}{range}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{20}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}

        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{i}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{target}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{i}\PYG{o}{+}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{o}{\PYGZpc{}} \PYG{l+m+mi}{20}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{physical}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{target\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{physical}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}
    \PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Digital layer: random connections (more global)}

\PYG{n}{rng} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{np}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{random}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{default\PYGZus{}rng}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{42}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{\PYGZus{}} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n+nb}{range}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{30}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}

\paragraph{Understanding SIR Parameters}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:understanding-sir-parameters}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The \sphinxstylestrong{basic reproduction number} R\(\sb{\text{0}}\) determines epidemic outcome:
\begin{equation*}
\begin{split}R_0 = \\frac{\\beta}{\\gamma} \\times \\langle k \\rangle\end{split}
\end{equation*}
\sphinxAtStartPar
where \(\\langle k \\rangle\) is the average degree.
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{R\(\sb{\text{0}}\) \textgreater{} 1}: Epidemic spreads (each infected person infects \textgreater{}1 others on average)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{R\(\sb{\text{0}}\) \textless{} 1}: Epidemic dies out quickly

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{R\(\sb{\text{0}}\) ≈ 1}: Epidemic threshold — critical point

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Parameter Effects:}

    \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{beta}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.3}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{gamma}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.05}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{label}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Slow recovery}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{,}

\PYG{p}{]}

\subsubsection{SIS Epidemic Dynamics}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:sis-epidemic-dynamics}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The \sphinxstylestrong{SIS model} simulates diseases without lasting immunity — individuals recover but can be immediately re\sphinxhyphen{}infected. This creates an \sphinxstylestrong{endemic equilibrium} where infection persists indefinitely (unlike SIR which always dies out).

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{States:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{S (Susceptible)} — Not infected, can become infected

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{I (Infected)} — Currently infected, can transmit and recover

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{No recovered state} — recovered individuals return to susceptible.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Parameters:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{beta}} (β) — Transmission rate

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{gamma}} (γ) — Recovery rate

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{initial\_infected}} — Fraction or number initially infected

\end{itemize}


\paragraph{Basic Example}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:id1}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dynamics}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{SISDynamics}
\PYG{k+kn}{import}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{networkx}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k}{as}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{nx}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create a small\PYGZhy{}world network}
\PYG{n}{G} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{nx}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{watts\PYGZus{}strogatz\PYGZus{}graph}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{n}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{100}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{k}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{6}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{p}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.1}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{seed}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{42}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create SIS dynamics}
\PYG{n}{sis} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{SISDynamics}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{G}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{beta}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.3}\PYG{p}{,}      \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Infection rate}
    \PYG{n}{gamma}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.1}\PYG{p}{,}     \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Recovery rate}
    \PYG{n}{initial\PYGZus{}infected}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.05}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Set seed and run}
\PYG{n}{sis}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{set\PYGZus{}seed}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{42}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{results} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{sis}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{run}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{steps}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{200}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Extract measures}
\PYG{n}{prevalence} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{results}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}measure}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{prevalence}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Endemic equilibrium (mean of last 50 steps)}
\PYG{n}{endemic\PYGZus{}level} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{prevalence}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}}\PYG{l+m+mi}{50}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Endemic prevalence: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{endemic\PYGZus{}level}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.2\PYGZpc{}}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Std deviation: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{prevalence}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}}\PYG{l+m+mi}{50}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{std}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.2\PYGZpc{}}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar

\paragraph{SIS vs SIR Comparison}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:sis-vs-sir-comparison}}
\sphinxAtStartPar

\PYG{k+kn}{import}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{matplotlib}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{pyplot}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k}{as}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{plt}

\PYG{n}{G} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{nx}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{karate\PYGZus{}club\PYGZus{}graph}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} SIS dynamics}

\PYG{n}{sis}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{set\PYGZus{}seed}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{42}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{sis\PYGZus{}results} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{sis}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{run}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{steps}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{100}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{sis\PYGZus{}prevalence} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{sis\PYGZus{}results}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}measure}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{prevalence}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{sir}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{set\PYGZus{}seed}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{42}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{sir\PYGZus{}prevalence} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{sir\PYGZus{}results}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}measure}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{prevalence}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Plot comparison}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{figure}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{figsize}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{6}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{legend}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{grid}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{alpha}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.3}\PYG{p}{)}

\paragraph{Endemic Threshold}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:endemic-threshold}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
SIS has an \sphinxstylestrong{epidemic threshold} below which infection dies out:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{G} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{nx}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{karate\PYGZus{}club\PYGZus{}graph}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{avg\PYGZus{}degree} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{l+m+mi}{2} \PYG{o}{*} \PYG{n}{G}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{number\PYGZus{}of\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{o}{/} \PYG{n}{G}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{number\PYGZus{}of\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{gamma} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.1}
\PYG{n}{beta\PYGZus{}values} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.01}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.02}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.03}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.05}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.1}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.2}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.3}\PYG{p}{]}

\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{beta} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{beta\PYGZus{}values}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{sis} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{SISDynamics}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{G}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{beta}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{beta}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{gamma}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{gamma}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{initial\PYGZus{}infected}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.1}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n}{sis}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{set\PYGZus{}seed}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{42}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n}{results} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{sis}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{run}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{steps}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{200}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n}{prevalence} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{results}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}measure}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{prevalence}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Endemic level (mean of last 50 steps)}
    \PYG{n}{endemic} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{prevalence}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}}\PYG{l+m+mi}{50}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n}{R0} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{beta} \PYG{o}{/} \PYG{n}{gamma} \PYG{o}{*} \PYG{n}{avg\PYGZus{}degree}
    \PYG{n}{status} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{endemic}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}} \PYG{k}{if} \PYG{n}{endemic} \PYG{o}{\PYGZgt{}} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.01} \PYG{k}{else} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{extinct}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}

    \PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{β=}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{beta}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.2f}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{, R\(\sb{\text{0}}\)=}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{R0}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.2f}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{endemic}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.2\PYGZpc{}}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{ (}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{status}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{)}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar

\subsubsection{Random Walk Dynamics}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:random-walk-dynamics}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Random walks simulate \sphinxstylestrong{exploration} and \sphinxstylestrong{diffusion} on networks. At each step, a walker moves to a random neighbor (or stays in place with some probability).

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Use cases:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Computing \sphinxstylestrong{PageRank} and other centrality measures

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Modeling \sphinxstylestrong{search} and \sphinxstylestrong{navigation}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Analyzing \sphinxstylestrong{community structure} through exploration patterns

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Understanding \sphinxstylestrong{information diffusion}

\end{itemize}


\paragraph{Basic Example}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:id2}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dynamics}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{RandomWalkDynamics}
\PYG{k+kn}{import}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{networkx}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k}{as}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{nx}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create network}
\PYG{n}{G} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{nx}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{karate\PYGZus{}club\PYGZus{}graph}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create random walk starting at node 0}
\PYG{n}{walk} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{RandomWalkDynamics}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{G}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{start\PYGZus{}node}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{0}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{lazy\PYGZus{}probability}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.1}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} 10\PYGZpc{} chance to stay in place}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Set seed and run}
\PYG{n}{walk}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{set\PYGZus{}seed}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{42}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{results} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{walk}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{run}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{steps}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1000}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get trajectory}
\PYG{n}{trajectory} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{results}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}measure}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{trajectory}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Walk length: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{trajectory}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Start: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{trajectory}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+m+mi}{0}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{, End: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{trajectory}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Count visits}
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{collections}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Counter}
\PYG{n}{visits} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Counter}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{trajectory}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}5} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{visits}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{most\PYGZus{}common}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Most visited nodes:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{node}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{count} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}5}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{  Node }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{node}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{count}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{ visits}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\paragraph{Multilayer Random Walk}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:multilayer-random-walk}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Random walks on multilayer networks can \sphinxstylestrong{switch between layers} at inter\sphinxhyphen{}layer connections:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{multinet}
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dynamics}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{RandomWalkDynamics}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create two\PYGZhy{}layer network with different structures}
\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{directed}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{n} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{l+m+mi}{15}
\PYG{n}{nodes} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{]}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{i} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n+nb}{range}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{n}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{append}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{i}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{ring}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{append}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{i}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{star}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Layer 1: Ring topology}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{i} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n+nb}{range}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{n}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{i}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{target}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{i}\PYG{o}{+}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{o}{\PYGZpc{}} \PYG{n}{n}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{ring}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{target\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{ring}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}
    \PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Layer 2: Star topology (node 0 is hub)}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{i} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n+nb}{range}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{n}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+m+mi}{0}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{target}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{i}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{star}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{target\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{star}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}
    \PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Inter\PYGZhy{}layer connections}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{i} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n+nb}{range}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{n}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{i}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{target}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{i}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{ring}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{target\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{star}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}
    \PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Run random walk}
\PYG{n}{walk} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{RandomWalkDynamics}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{start\PYGZus{}node}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{0}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{ring}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{walk}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{set\PYGZus{}seed}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{42}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{results} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{walk}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{run}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{steps}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1000}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Analyze layer switching}

\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{i} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n+nb}{range}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{trajectory}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}} \PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Layer switches: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{switches}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\paragraph{Lazy Random Walks}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:lazy-random-walks}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The \sphinxstylestrong{lazy probability} controls how often the walker stays in place:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{import}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{networkx}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k}{as}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{nx}
\PYG{k+kn}{import}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{matplotlib}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{pyplot}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k}{as}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{plt}

\PYG{n}{G} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{nx}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{path\PYGZus{}graph}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{20}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Simple chain}

\PYG{n}{lazy\PYGZus{}probs} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.0}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.2}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.5}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.8}\PYG{p}{]}

\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{figure}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{figsize}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{6}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{lazy\PYGZus{}p} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{lazy\PYGZus{}probs}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{walk} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{RandomWalkDynamics}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{G}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{start\PYGZus{}node}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{,}
                              \PYG{n}{lazy\PYGZus{}probability}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{lazy\PYGZus{}p}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n}{walk}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{set\PYGZus{}seed}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{42}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n}{results} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{walk}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{run}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{steps}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{100}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n}{trajectory} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{results}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}measure}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{trajectory}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{plot}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{trajectory}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{label}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Lazy p=}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{lazy\PYGZus{}p}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
            \PYG{n}{linewidth}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{2}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{alpha}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.7}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{xlabel}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Time step}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{ylabel}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Node position}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{title}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Random Walk with Different Lazy Probabilities}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{legend}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{grid}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{alpha}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.3}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{show}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\subsubsection{Working with Results}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:working-with-results}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
All dynamics simulations return a \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{DynamicsResult}} object with rich output measures.


\paragraph{Available Measures}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:available-measures}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Epidemic Models (SIR, SIS):}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{"prevalence"}} — Fraction of nodes infected at each time step (array)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{"state\_counts"}} — Count of nodes in each state over time (dict of arrays)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{"trajectory"}} — Full state history (list of dicts mapping node \(\rightarrow\) state)

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Random Walk:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{"trajectory"}} — Sequence of visited nodes (list)

\end{itemize}


\paragraph{Extracting Measures}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:extracting-measures}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Run simulation}
\PYG{n}{sir} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{SIRDynamics}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{G}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{beta}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.3}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{gamma}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.1}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{sir}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{set\PYGZus{}seed}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{42}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{results} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{sir}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{run}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{steps}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{100}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get prevalence over time}
\PYG{n}{prevalence} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{results}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}measure}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{prevalence}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get state counts}
\PYG{n}{state\PYGZus{}counts} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{results}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}measure}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{state\PYGZus{}counts}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{S} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{state\PYGZus{}counts}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{S}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Susceptible over time}
\PYG{n}{I} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{state\PYGZus{}counts}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{I}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Infected over time}
\PYG{n}{R} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{state\PYGZus{}counts}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{R}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Recovered over time}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get full trajectory (memory intensive for large networks)}
\PYG{n}{trajectory} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{results}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}measure}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{trajectory}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} trajectory[t] is dict: \PYGZob{}node: state\PYGZcb{} at time t}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Converting to Pandas}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Convert to pandas DataFrame}
\PYG{n}{df\PYGZus{}dict} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{results}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Export to CSV}
\PYG{n}{prevalence\PYGZus{}df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}csv}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{prevalence.csv}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{state\PYGZus{}counts\PYGZus{}df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}csv}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{state\PYGZus{}counts.csv}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\PYG{n}{ax1}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{plot}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{steps}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{state\PYGZus{}counts}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{S}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{label}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Susceptible}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}

\PYG{n}{ax1}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{plot}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{steps}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{state\PYGZus{}counts}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{I}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{label}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Infected}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}

\PYG{n}{ax1}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{plot}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{steps}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{state\PYGZus{}counts}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{R}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{label}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Recovered}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}

\PYG{n}{ax1}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{set\PYGZus{}ylabel}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Number of nodes}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{ax1}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{set\PYGZus{}title}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{SIR Epidemic Dynamics}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{ax1}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{legend}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{ax1}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{grid}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{alpha}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.3}\PYG{p}{)}

\subsubsection{Mathematical Formalism}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:mathematical-formalism}}

\paragraph{SIR Model}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:sir-model}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Discrete\sphinxhyphen{}time update rules} (per time step):

\sphinxAtStartPar
For each susceptible node \sphinxstyleemphasis{i}:
\begin{equation*}
\begin{split}P(S_i \\rightarrow I_i) = 1 - \\prod_{j \\in N(i)} (1 - \\beta)^{\\mathbb{1}_{I_j}}\end{split}
\end{equation*}
\sphinxAtStartPar
where \(N(i)\) are neighbors and \(\\mathbb{1}_{I_j}\) indicates if neighbor \sphinxstyleemphasis{j} is infected.

\sphinxAtStartPar
For each infected node \sphinxstyleemphasis{i}:
\begin{equation*}
\begin{split}P(I_i \\rightarrow R_i) = \\gamma\end{split}
\end{equation*}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Continuous\sphinxhyphen{}time interpretation:}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Transition rates: \(S \\xrightarrow{\\beta \\lambda_i} I \\xrightarrow{\\gamma} R\)

\sphinxAtStartPar
where \(\\lambda_i = \\sum_{j \\in N(i)} \\mathbb{1}_{I_j}\) is the number of infected neighbors.


\paragraph{SIS Model}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:sis-model}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Discrete\sphinxhyphen{}time update rules:}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Same infection rule as SIR, but recovery returns to susceptible:
\begin{equation*}
\begin{split}P(I_i \\rightarrow S_i) = \\gamma\end{split}
\end{equation*}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Endemic equilibrium} (mean\sphinxhyphen{}field approximation):
\begin{equation*}
\begin{split}\\rho^* = 1 - \\frac{\\gamma}{\\beta \\langle k \\rangle}\end{split}
\end{equation*}
\sphinxAtStartPar
where \(\\rho^*\) is endemic prevalence and \(\\langle k \\rangle\) is average degree.


\paragraph{Random Walk}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:random-walk}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Transition probability} from node \sphinxstyleemphasis{i} to node \sphinxstyleemphasis{j}:
\begin{equation*}
\begin{split}P(i \\rightarrow j) =
\\begin{cases}
p_{\\text{lazy}} & \\text{if } j = i \\\\
\\frac{1 - p_{\\text{lazy}}}{\\text{degree}(i)} & \\text{if } j \\in N(i) \\\\
0 & \\text{otherwise}
\\end{cases}\end{split}
\end{equation*}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Stationary distribution} (long\sphinxhyphen{}run proportion of time at each node):
\begin{equation*}
\begin{split}\\pi_i \\propto \\text{degree}(i)\end{split}
\end{equation*}
\sphinxAtStartPar
High\sphinxhyphen{}degree nodes are visited more frequently.


\bigskip\hrule\bigskip



\subsubsection{Advanced Topics}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:advanced-topics}}

\paragraph{Multilayer Coupling}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:multilayer-coupling}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
In multilayer networks, nodes can have \sphinxstylestrong{different infection states in different layers} (weak coupling) or \sphinxstylestrong{share a single state across all layers} (strong coupling).

\sphinxAtStartPar
py3plex uses \sphinxstylestrong{strong coupling by default} — each node has one state shared across all its layer\sphinxhyphen{}specific replicas. This is appropriate for most epidemic models (a person is either infected or not, regardless of which social context you observe them in).

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Strong coupling (default): node state shared across layers}
\PYG{n}{sir} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{SIRDynamics}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{multilayer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{beta}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.3}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{gamma}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.1}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Infection can spread through any layer}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Recovery is per\PYGZhy{}node, not per\PYGZhy{}layer}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Time\sphinxhyphen{}Varying Parameters}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:time-varying-parameters}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Parameters can be \sphinxstylestrong{functions of time} for more realistic models:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Seasonal variation in transmission}
\PYG{k}{def}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nf}{seasonal\PYGZus{}beta}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{t}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{k+kn}{import}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{math}
    \PYG{k}{return} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.3} \PYG{o}{*} \PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1} \PYG{o}{+} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.5} \PYG{o}{*} \PYG{n}{math}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{sin}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{2} \PYG{o}{*} \PYG{n}{math}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{pi} \PYG{o}{*} \PYG{n}{t} \PYG{o}{/} \PYG{l+m+mi}{365}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Note: Advanced feature, check core module support}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} sir = SIRDynamics(G, beta=seasonal\PYGZus{}beta, gamma=0.1)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Heterogeneous Parameters}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:heterogeneous-parameters}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Different nodes can have different recovery rates:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{import}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{numpy}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k}{as}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{np}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Assign random recovery rates}
\PYG{n}{n\PYGZus{}nodes} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{G}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{number\PYGZus{}of\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{recovery\PYGZus{}rates} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{np}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{random}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{uniform}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.05}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.15}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{n\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Note: Advanced feature, check core module support}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} sir = SIRDynamics(G, beta=0.3, gamma=recovery\PYGZus{}rates)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\bigskip\hrule\bigskip



\subsubsection{Performance Considerations}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:performance-considerations}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Simulation speed} depends on:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Network size}: Larger networks take longer

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Number of steps}: More steps = more computation

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Trajectory storage}: Storing full state history uses memory

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Tips for efficiency:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} For large networks, avoid storing full trajectory}
\PYG{n}{results} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{sir}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{run}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{steps}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{100}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Only extract measures you need}
\PYG{n}{prevalence} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{results}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}measure}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{prevalence}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Lightweight}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} trajectory = results.get\PYGZus{}measure(\PYGZdq{}trajectory\PYGZdq{})  \PYGZsh{} Heavy for large networks}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Use moderate step counts for exploration}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Refine with more steps once parameters are tuned}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Typical performance} (on modern laptop):
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Network with 1000 nodes, 100 steps: \textasciitilde{}1 second

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Network with 10,000 nodes, 100 steps: \textasciitilde{}10 seconds

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Network with 100,000 nodes, 100 steps: \textasciitilde{}2 minutes

\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{DSL Integration}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/multilayer_dynamics:dsl-integration}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The {\hyperref[\detokenize{user_guide/dsl::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{SQL\sphinxhyphen{}like DSL for Multilayer Networks}}}} provides declarative syntax for dynamics:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Define simulation}
\PYG{n}{sim} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{D}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{process}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{SIS}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{beta}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.3}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{mu}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.1}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{initial}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{infected}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.05}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{steps}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{100}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{measure}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{prevalence}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{incidence}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{replicates}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Run 10 independent trials}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{seed}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{42}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Execute}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{sim}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{run}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Aggregate across replicates}
\PYG{n}{mean\PYGZus{}prevalence} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{data}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{prevalence}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{axis}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{0}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{std\PYGZus{}prevalence} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{data}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{prevalence}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{std}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{axis}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{0}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\subsection{Random Walk Algorithms}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/random_walks_embeddings:random-walk-algorithms}}\label{\detokenize{user_guide/random_walks_embeddings::doc}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Py3plex provides comprehensive random walk primitives for graph\sphinxhyphen{}based algorithms,
including Node2Vec, DeepWalk, and diffusion processes. These implementations support
weighted, directed, and multilayer networks with deterministic reproducibility.


\subsubsection{Overview}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/random_walks_embeddings:overview}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Random walks are fundamental building blocks for many graph algorithms:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Node2Vec}: Learn node embeddings using biased random walks

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{DeepWalk}: Generate node embeddings through uniform random walks

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Personalized PageRank}: Compute node importance via random walks with restart

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Diffusion processes}: Model information or disease propagation

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Community detection}: Identify network structure through walk patterns

\end{itemize}


\paragraph{Key Features}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/random_walks_embeddings:key-features}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
{[}OK{]} Basic random walks with proper edge weight handling

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
{[}OK{]} Second\sphinxhyphen{}order (biased) random walks following Node2Vec logic

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
{[}OK{]} Multiple simultaneous walks with deterministic seeding

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
{[}OK{]} Support for directed, weighted, and multigraphs

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
{[}OK{]} Multilayer network\sphinxhyphen{}aware walks with layer constraints

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
{[}OK{]} Efficient sparse adjacency matrix handling

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
{[}OK{]} Comprehensive test suite validating correctness properties

\end{itemize}


\subsubsection{Basic Random Walk}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/random_walks_embeddings:basic-random-walk}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The basic random walk samples the next node proportionally to normalized edge weights.


\paragraph{Simple Example}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/random_walks_embeddings:simple-example}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{algorithms}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{general}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{walkers}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{basic\PYGZus{}random\PYGZus{}walk}
\PYG{k+kn}{import}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{networkx}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k}{as}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{nx}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create a simple graph}
\PYG{n}{G} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{nx}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{karate\PYGZus{}club\PYGZus{}graph}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Perform a random walk}
\PYG{n}{walk} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{basic\PYGZus{}random\PYGZus{}walk}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{G}\PYG{p}{,}

\subsubsection{Node2Vec Biased Random Walk}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/random_walks_embeddings:node2vec-biased-random-walk}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Second\sphinxhyphen{}order random walks with return parameter \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{p}} and in\sphinxhyphen{}out parameter \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{q}}
following the Node2Vec algorithm (Grover \& Leskovec, 2016).


\paragraph{Parameters}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/random_walks_embeddings:parameters}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
When transitioning from node \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{t \(\rightarrow\) v \(\rightarrow\) x}}, the probability of choosing \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{x}} is biased:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{If x == t} (return to previous): \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{weight / p}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{If x is neighbor of t} (stay close): \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{weight / 1}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{If x is not neighbor of t} (explore): \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{weight / q}}

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Parameter Effects:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{p \textgreater{} 1}: Less likely to return to previous node (explore forward)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{p \textless{} 1}: More likely to return (backtrack)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{q \textgreater{} 1}: Less likely to explore distant nodes (stay local, BFS\sphinxhyphen{}like)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{q \textless{} 1}: More likely to explore distant nodes (venture far, DFS\sphinxhyphen{}like)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{p = q = 1}: Equivalent to basic random walk

\end{itemize}

\paragraph{Uniformity Test}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/random_walks_embeddings:uniformity-test}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
On unweighted regular graphs, transition probabilities are uniform:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{import}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{networkx}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k}{as}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{nx}
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{algorithms}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{general}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{walkers}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{basic\PYGZus{}random\PYGZus{}walk}
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{collections}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Counter}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Complete graph (regular)}
\PYG{n}{G} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{nx}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{complete\PYGZus{}graph}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Count visits to neighbors from node 0}
\PYG{n}{visits} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Counter}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{i} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n+nb}{range}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10000}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{walk} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{basic\PYGZus{}random\PYGZus{}walk}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{G}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{0}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{weighted}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{seed}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{i}\PYG{p}{)}

\paragraph{P and Q Parameter Effects}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/random_walks_embeddings:p-and-q-parameter-effects}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The p and q parameters control the walk’s exploration behavior:

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Return parameter p:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{p \textless{} 1:} More likely to backtrack (return to previous node)
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use when: Local structure is important; you want to capture tight clusters

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{p = 1:} Balanced (equivalent to basic random walk for backtracking)
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use when: No prior about network structure

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{p \textgreater{} 1:} Less likely to backtrack (move forward)
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use when: You want walks to explore broadly

\end{itemize}

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{In\sphinxhyphen{}out parameter q:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{q \textless{} 1:} More likely to explore distant nodes (DFS\sphinxhyphen{}like)
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use when: You want to capture global structure, find communities

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{q = 1:} Balanced exploration
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use when: No prior about network structure

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{q \textgreater{} 1:} More likely to stay in local neighborhood (BFS\sphinxhyphen{}like)
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use when: You want to capture local structure, homophily

\end{itemize}

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Common presets:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Local/homophily\PYGZhy{}focused (similar to BFS)}
\PYG{n}{p}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{q} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{2.0}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Global/structural (similar to DFS)}
\PYG{n}{p}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{q} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.5}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Balanced (DeepWalk\PYGZhy{}like)}
\PYG{n}{p}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{q} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Strong local focus}
\PYG{n}{p}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{q} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.5}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{2.0}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Strong exploration}
\PYG{n}{p}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{q} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{l+m+mf}{2.0}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.5}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\subsection{I/O and Serialization}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/io_and_formats:i-o-and-serialization}}\label{\detokenize{user_guide/io_and_formats::doc}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
py3plex provides a comprehensive I/O system for reading and writing multilayer graphs in various formats. The system is designed to be extensible, efficient, and easy to use.

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{note}{DSL Example: Export Query Results}

\sphinxAtStartPar
DSL makes it easy to export analysis results:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{L}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Analyze and export in one pipeline}
\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{+} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{work}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZhy{}betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{limit}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{100}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{export\PYGZus{}csv}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{top\PYGZus{}influencers.csv}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{export\PYGZus{}json}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{top\PYGZus{}influencers.json}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Results automatically saved to files!}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Declarative exports streamline data analysis workflows!
\end{sphinxadmonition}


\subsubsection{Supported Formats}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/io_and_formats:supported-formats}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The I/O system supports multiple file formats, each with different trade\sphinxhyphen{}offs:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{JSON} \sphinxhyphen{} Human\sphinxhyphen{}readable, widely compatible, good for small to medium networks

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{JSONL} \sphinxhyphen{} Streaming JSON format, efficient for large networks

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{CSV} \sphinxhyphen{} Spreadsheet\sphinxhyphen{}compatible, easy to edit manually

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Arrow/Feather} \sphinxhyphen{} High\sphinxhyphen{}performance columnar format (requires pyarrow)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Parquet} \sphinxhyphen{} Compressed columnar format, best for storage (requires pyarrow)

\end{itemize}


\subsubsection{Basic Usage}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/io_and_formats:basic-usage}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The I/O system provides two main functions: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{read()}} and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{write()}}.


\paragraph{Reading Graphs}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/io_and_formats:reading-graphs}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{io}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{read}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Auto\PYGZhy{}detect format from extension}
\PYG{n}{graph} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{read}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network.json}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{graph} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{read}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network.csv}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{graph} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{read}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network.arrow}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Or specify format explicitly}
\PYG{n}{graph} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{read}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{myfile.dat}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n+nb}{format}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{json}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Writing Graphs}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/io_and_formats:writing-graphs}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{io}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{write}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Auto\PYGZhy{}detect format from extension}
\PYG{n}{write}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network.json}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{write}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network.arrow}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{write}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network.parquet}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Or specify format explicitly}
\PYG{n}{write}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{myfile.dat}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n+nb}{format}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{json}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\subsubsection{Creating Graphs with the Schema API}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/io_and_formats:creating-graphs-with-the-schema-api}}

The modern I/O system uses a schema\sphinxhyphen{}based API for creating graphs:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{io}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{MultiLayerGraph}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{Node}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{Layer}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{Edge}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create graph}
\PYG{n}{graph} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{MultiLayerGraph}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{directed}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{attributes}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{name}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Social Network}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Add layers}
\PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{Layer}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n+nb}{id}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{facebook}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{attributes}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{social}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{Layer}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n+nb}{id}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{twitter}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{attributes}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{social}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Add nodes}
\PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}node}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{Node}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n+nb}{id}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{attributes}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{age}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+m+mi}{30}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}node}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{Node}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n+nb}{id}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{attributes}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{age}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+m+mi}{25}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Add edges}
\PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}edge}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{Edge}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{src}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}

    \PYG{n}{dst\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{facebook}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{attributes}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{weight}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.8}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}
\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\subsubsection{Apache Arrow Format}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/io_and_formats:apache-arrow-format}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Apache Arrow is a high\sphinxhyphen{}performance columnar format designed for efficient data interchange. py3plex supports Arrow through two sub\sphinxhyphen{}formats:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Feather} \sphinxhyphen{} Fast, uncompressed format ideal for temporary storage

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Parquet} \sphinxhyphen{} Compressed format ideal for long\sphinxhyphen{}term storage

\end{itemize}


\paragraph{Installing Arrow Support}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/io_and_formats:installing-arrow-support}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Arrow support requires the pyarrow package:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
pip\PYG{+w}{ }install\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}py3plex[arrow]\PYGZsq{}}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} or directly}
pip\PYG{+w}{ }install\PYG{+w}{ }pyarrow
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Using Arrow Format}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/io_and_formats:using-arrow-format}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{io}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{read}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{write}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Feather format (fast, uncompressed)}
\PYG{n}{write}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network.arrow}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{graph} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{read}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network.arrow}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Parquet format (compressed)}
\PYG{n}{write}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network.parquet}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n+nb}{format}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{parquet}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{graph} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{read}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network.parquet}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n+nb}{format}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{parquet}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Benefits of Arrow Format}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/io_and_formats:benefits-of-arrow-format}}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Performance}: Columnar storage enables fast read/write operations

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Compression}: Parquet format provides excellent compression ratios

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Interoperability}: Arrow is an industry\sphinxhyphen{}standard format supported by:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
pandas, polars (Python data analysis)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Apache Spark (big data processing)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
R, Julia (statistical computing)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
DuckDB (analytical database)

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Type Safety}: Schema preservation with strong typing

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Zero\sphinxhyphen{}Copy}: Efficient in\sphinxhyphen{}memory representation

\end{enumerate}
