\paragraph{When to Use Each Format}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/io_and_formats:when-to-use-each-format}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Use Arrow/Feather when:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
You need maximum read/write performance

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Working with large networks (\textgreater{}10k nodes)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Interoperating with data science tools (pandas, polars)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Building data pipelines

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Use Parquet when:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Long\sphinxhyphen{}term storage is important

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Minimizing storage costs

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Sharing data across platforms

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Archiving networks

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Use JSON when:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Human readability is important

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Working with small networks

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Debugging or manual editing

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Maximum compatibility needed

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Use CSV when:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Working with spreadsheet tools (Excel)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Simple edge lists

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Manual data entry/editing

\end{itemize}


\subsubsection{CSV Format with Sidecars}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/io_and_formats:csv-format-with-sidecars}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
CSV format supports optional sidecar files for node and layer attributes:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{io}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{read}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{write}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Write with sidecars}
\PYG{n}{write}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{edges.csv}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n+nb}{format}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{csv}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{write\PYGZus{}sidecars}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Creates: edges.csv, nodes.csv, layers.csv}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Read with sidecars}
\PYG{n}{graph} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{read}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{edges.csv}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n+nb}{format}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{csv}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
             \PYG{n}{nodes\PYGZus{}file}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{nodes.csv}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
             \PYG{n}{layers\PYGZus{}file}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layers.csv}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\subsubsection{Integration with NetworkX}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/io_and_formats:integration-with-networkx}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Convert between py3plex I/O format and NetworkX:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{io}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{read}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}networkx}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}networkx}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Load graph}
\PYG{n}{graph} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{read}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network.json}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Convert to NetworkX}
\PYG{n}{G} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}networkx}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{mode}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{union}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Merge all layers}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} or}
\PYG{n}{G} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}networkx}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{mode}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{multiplex}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Preserve layers as (node, layer)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Convert back from NetworkX}
\PYG{n}{graph} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}networkx}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{G}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{mode}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{multiplex}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\subsubsection{Example: Complete Workflow}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/io_and_formats:example-complete-workflow}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Here’s a complete example demonstrating the I/O system:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{io}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{MultiLayerGraph}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{Node}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{Layer}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{Edge}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{read}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{write}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}networkx}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create a multilayer network}
\PYG{n}{graph} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{MultiLayerGraph}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{directed}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Add layers}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}id} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{social}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{work}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{family}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{Layer}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n+nb}{id}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}id}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Add nodes}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{name} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{charlie}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}node}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{Node}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n+nb}{id}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{name}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Add edges}
\PYG{n}{edges} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{[}
    \PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{social}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{social}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.8}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{charlie}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{work}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{work}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.6}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{charlie}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{family}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{family}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.9}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
\PYG{p}{]}

\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{src}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{dst}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{src\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{dst\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{weight} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{edges}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}edge}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{Edge}\PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{src}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{src}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{dst}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{dst}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{n}{src\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{src\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{dst\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{dst\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{n}{attributes}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{weight}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{weight}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}
    \PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Save in multiple formats}
\PYG{n}{write}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network.json}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{write}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network.arrow}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{write}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network.parquet}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Load back}
\PYG{n}{loaded} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{read}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network.arrow}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Convert to NetworkX for analysis}
\PYG{n}{G} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}networkx}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{loaded}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{mode}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{union}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Use NetworkX algorithms}
\PYG{k+kn}{import}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{networkx}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k}{as}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{nx}
\PYG{n}{centrality} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{nx}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{G}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Most central node: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{max}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{centrality}\PYG{p}{,}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n}{key}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{centrality}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\subsubsection{Checking Supported Formats}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/io_and_formats:checking-supported-formats}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
You can query which formats are available at runtime:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{io}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{supported\PYGZus{}formats}

\PYG{n}{formats} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{supported\PYGZus{}formats}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Read formats: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{formats}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{read}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Write formats: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{formats}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{write}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
This is useful for checking if optional dependencies (like pyarrow) are installed.


\subsubsection{Schema Validation}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/io_and_formats:schema-validation}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The I/O system includes automatic validation:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{io}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{MultiLayerGraph}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{Node}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{Edge}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{ReferentialIntegrityError}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{graph} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{MultiLayerGraph}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}node}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{Node}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n+nb}{id}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{k}{try}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} This will fail \PYGZhy{} bob doesn\PYGZsq{}t exist}
    \PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}edge}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{Edge}\PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{src}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{dst}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{n}{src\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{l1}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{dst\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{l1}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}
    \PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{k}{except} \PYG{n}{ReferentialIntegrityError} \PYG{k}{as} \PYG{n}{e}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Validation error: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{e}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Validation ensures:
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
All edge endpoints reference existing nodes

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
All edge layers reference existing layers

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
All attributes are JSON\sphinxhyphen{}serializable

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
No duplicate edges (by src, dst, src\_layer, dst\_layer, key)

\end{enumerate}


\subsubsection{Advanced: Custom Formats}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/io_and_formats:advanced-custom-formats}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The I/O system is extensible. You can register custom format readers/writers:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{io}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{register\PYGZus{}reader}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{register\PYGZus{}writer}

\PYG{k}{def}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nf}{my\PYGZus{}reader}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{filepath}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{o}{*}\PYG{o}{*}\PYG{n}{kwargs}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Custom reading logic}
    \PYG{n}{graph} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{MultiLayerGraph}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} ... populate graph ...}
    \PYG{k}{return} \PYG{n}{graph}

\PYG{k}{def}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nf}{my\PYGZus{}writer}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{filepath}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{o}{*}\PYG{o}{*}\PYG{n}{kwargs}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Custom writing logic}
    \PYG{k}{with} \PYG{n+nb}{open}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{filepath}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{w}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{k}{as} \PYG{n}{f}\PYG{p}{:}
        \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} ... write graph ...}
        \PYG{k}{pass}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Register}
\PYG{n}{register\PYGZus{}reader}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{myformat}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{my\PYGZus{}reader}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{register\PYGZus{}writer}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{myformat}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{my\PYGZus{}writer}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Now you can use it}
\PYG{n}{write}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{graph}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network.myformat}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{graph} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{read}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network.myformat}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\subsection{Visualization}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization:visualization}}\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization::doc}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleemphasis{From hairball to insight: making multilayer networks visible.}

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{note}{DSL Tip: Filter Before Visualizing}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Use DSL to create focused visualizations:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{L}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get high\PYGZhy{}degree nodes for cleaner visualization}
\PYG{n}{important\PYGZus{}nodes} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create subnetwork with just these nodes}
\PYG{n}{subgraph} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{important\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}networkx}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Now visualize the focused subgraph}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} (clearer than visualizing entire network)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Filter first, visualize second for better insights!
\end{sphinxadmonition}


\bigskip\hrule\bigskip


\sphinxAtStartPar
A network you can’t see is a network you can’t understand. Visualization transforms abstract adjacency structures into spatial patterns that human perception can process—clusters become visible groups, hubs become prominent nodes, and cross\sphinxhyphen{}layer connections become the bridges they conceptually are.

\sphinxAtStartPar
This chapter shows you how to create visualizations that reveal structure rather than obscure it. We’ll cover:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Quick plots} for exploration and debugging

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Preset modes} optimized for different network scales

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Layout algorithms} that reveal different structural properties

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Interactive visualizations} for presentations and exploration

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Publication\sphinxhyphen{}ready figures} with proper formatting

\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{Quick Start}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization:quick-start}}

\paragraph{Basic Multilayer Visualization}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization:basic-multilayer-visualization}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{multinet}
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{visualization}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{multilayer}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{draw\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}default}
\PYG{k+kn}{import}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{matplotlib}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{pyplot}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k}{as}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{plt}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Load network}
\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{load\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{network.csv}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{input\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{multiedgelist}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get layer data (returns: labels, graphs, multilinks)}
\PYG{n}{labels}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{graphs}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{multilinks} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Visualize with defaults}
\PYG{n}{draw\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}default}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{graphs}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{display}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{labels}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{labels}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\subsubsection{Preset Visualization Modes}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization:preset-visualization-modes}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Py3plex provides three preset modes optimized for different network scales and use cases.


\paragraph{Minimal Mode (Large Networks \textgreater{}1000 nodes)}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization:minimal-mode-large-networks-1000-nodes}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Optimized for networks with many nodes where detail isn’t critical.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{visualization}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{multilayer}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{draw\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}default}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get layer data}
\PYG{n}{labels}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{graphs}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{multilinks} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Minimal preset for large networks}
\PYG{n}{draw\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}default}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{graphs}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Node settings}
    \PYG{n}{node\PYGZus{}size}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{,}              \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Small nodes}
    \PYG{n}{labels}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{,}             \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} No layer labels (too cluttered)}
    \PYG{n}{node\PYGZus{}labels}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{,}        \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} No node IDs}

    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Edge settings}
    \PYG{n}{edge\PYGZus{}size}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.5}\PYG{p}{,}            \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Thin edges}
    \PYG{n}{alphalevel}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.3}\PYG{p}{,}           \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Transparent edges (reduce clutter)}

    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Layout}
    \PYG{n}{background\PYGZus{}shape}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{circle}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Circular layout}

    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Display}
    \PYG{n}{display}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{remove\PYGZus{}isolated\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Clean up isolated nodes}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Use cases:}
\sphinxhyphen{} Large social networks (\textgreater{}1000 nodes)
\sphinxhyphen{} Overview visualizations
\sphinxhyphen{} Pattern detection at macro level
\sphinxhyphen{} Network topology understanding

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Advantages:}
\sphinxhyphen{} Fast rendering
\sphinxhyphen{} Reduced visual clutter
\sphinxhyphen{} Shows overall structure
\sphinxhyphen{} Works with many nodes


\paragraph{Balanced Mode (Medium Networks 100\sphinxhyphen{}1000 nodes)}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization:balanced-mode-medium-networks-100-1000-nodes}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Default settings that work well for most networks. Good balance between detail and clarity.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get layer data}
\PYG{n}{labels}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{graphs}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{multilinks} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Balanced preset (this is the default)}

    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Node settings}
    \PYG{n}{node\PYGZus{}size}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{,}             \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Medium nodes}
    \PYG{n}{labels}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{labels}\PYG{p}{,}            \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Show layer labels}
    \PYG{n}{node\PYGZus{}labels}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{,}        \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Node IDs hidden by default}

    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Edge settings}
    \PYG{n}{edge\PYGZus{}size}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{,}            \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Normal edge width}

    \PYG{n}{networks\PYGZus{}color}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{rainbow}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}   \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Auto\PYGZhy{}assign colors}

    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Display}
    \PYG{n}{display}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}
\PYG{p}{)}

\paragraph{Dense Mode (Small Networks \textless{}100 nodes)}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization:dense-mode-small-networks-100-nodes}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Maximum detail for small networks where every node and edge matters.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get layer data}
\PYG{n}{labels}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{graphs}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{multilinks} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Dense preset for small, detailed networks}

    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Node settings}
    \PYG{n}{node\PYGZus{}size}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{20}\PYG{p}{,}             \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Large nodes}
    \PYG{n}{labels}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{labels}\PYG{p}{,}            \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Show all labels}
    \PYG{n}{node\PYGZus{}labels}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{,}         \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Show node IDs}
    \PYG{n}{node\PYGZus{}font\PYGZus{}size}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{,}        \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Readable font}
    \PYG{n}{scale\PYGZus{}by\PYGZus{}size}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{,}       \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Scale by degree}

    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Edge settings}

\paragraph{Basic Interactive Hairball Plot}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization:basic-interactive-hairball-plot}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{interactive\_hairball\_plot}} function creates an interactive 2D network visualization:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{import}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{networkx}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k}{as}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{nx}
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{random\PYGZus{}generators}
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{visualization}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{multilayer}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{interactive\PYGZus{}hairball\PYGZus{}plot}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Generate a network}
\PYG{n}{multilayer\PYGZus{}net} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{random\PYGZus{}generators}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{random\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}ER}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{50}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{3}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.15}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{directed}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Convert to NetworkX graph}
\PYG{n}{network\PYGZus{}colors}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{G} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multilayer\PYGZus{}net}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{style}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{hairball}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Compute layout}
\PYG{n}{pos} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{nx}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{spring\PYGZus{}layout}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{G}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{iterations}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{50}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{seed}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{42}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Compute node sizes based on degree}
\PYG{n}{degrees} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n+nb}{dict}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{G}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{degree}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{max\PYGZus{}degree} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n+nb}{max}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degrees}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{values}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{node\PYGZus{}sizes} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10} \PYG{o}{+} \PYG{l+m+mi}{40} \PYG{o}{*} \PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degrees}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{n}{node}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{/} \PYG{n}{max\PYGZus{}degree}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{node} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{G}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{]}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create color mapping}
\PYG{n}{color\PYGZus{}mapping} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{node}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{node\PYGZus{}sizes}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{n}{i}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{i}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{node} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n+nb}{enumerate}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{G}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Generate interactive visualization}
\PYG{n}{fig} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{interactive\PYGZus{}hairball\PYGZus{}plot}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{G}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{nsizes}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{node\PYGZus{}sizes}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{final\PYGZus{}color\PYGZus{}mapping}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{color\PYGZus{}mapping}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{pos}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{pos}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{colorscale}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Viridis}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Options: Viridis, Rainbow, Blues, Reds, etc.}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Save to HTML file}
\PYG{k}{if} \PYG{n}{fig}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{fig}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{write\PYGZus{}html}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{network.html}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Interactive visualization saved to network.html}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]

    \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{professional}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Frank}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Grace}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Henry}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{family}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Charlie}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{David}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Ivan}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Jane}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Convert to aggregate graph}

\paragraph{Performance Guidelines}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization:performance-guidelines}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Network Size Recommendations:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{\textless{} 100 nodes}: All features work smoothly

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{100\sphinxhyphen{}500 nodes}: Good performance, all features

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{500\sphinxhyphen{}1000 nodes}: Usable, may have slight lag

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{1000\sphinxhyphen{}5000 nodes}: Sample nodes or use simplified styling

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{\textgreater{} 5000 nodes}: Use static visualizations instead

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Optimization Tips:}
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use constant node sizes for large networks

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Simplify color schemes (single color or discrete categories)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{nx.random\_layout()}} instead of \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{nx.spring\_layout()}} for speed

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Sample nodes for interactive exploration

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Consider static visualization for very large networks

\end{enumerate}

\paragraph{For Large Networks}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Sample 1000 random nodes}
\PYG{n}{all\PYGZus{}nodes} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n+nb}{list}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{sample\PYGZus{}nodes} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{random}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{sample}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{all\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n+nb}{min}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1000}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{all\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\subsubsection{Troubleshooting}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization:troubleshooting}}

\paragraph{Visualization Not Showing}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization:visualization-not-showing}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Issue:} Plot doesn’t appear

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Solutions:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Jupyter notebook: Enable inline plots}
\PYG{o}{\PYGZpc{}}\PYG{n}{matplotlib} \PYG{n}{inline}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Python script: Add plt.show()}
\PYG{n}{labels}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{graphs}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{multilinks} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{draw\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}default}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{graphs}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{display}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{show}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Headless server: Save to file}
\PYG{k+kn}{import}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{matplotlib}
\PYG{n}{matplotlib}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{use}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Agg}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Must be before importing pyplot}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Nodes Overlapping}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization:nodes-overlapping}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Issue:} Nodes overlap and are hard to distinguish

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Solutions:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{labels}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{graphs}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{multilinks} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} 1. Use smaller node size}
\PYG{n}{draw\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}default}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{graphs}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{node\PYGZus{}size}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} 2. Increase layout area}
\PYG{n}{draw\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}default}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{graphs}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{rectanglex}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{2.0}\PYG{p}{,}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Wider layout}
    \PYG{n}{rectangley}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{2.0}   \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Taller layout}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} 3. Sample nodes}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} (See \PYGZdq{}Performance Tips\PYGZdq{} above)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Labels Too Crowded}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization:labels-too-crowded}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Issue:} Layer labels overlap or are too dense

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Solutions:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{labels}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{graphs}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{multilinks} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} 1. Disable labels for large networks}
\PYG{n}{draw\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}default}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{graphs}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{labels}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} 2. Adjust label position}
\PYG{n}{draw\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}default}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{graphs}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{labels}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{labels}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{label\PYGZus{}position}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{1.2}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Move labels outward}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} 3. Use smaller font}
\PYG{n}{draw\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}default}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{graphs}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{node\PYGZus{}font\PYGZus{}size}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{3}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Smaller font}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\subsubsection{Advanced Visualization Modes}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization:advanced-visualization-modes}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Py3plex provides multiple specialized visualization modes for multilayer networks,
each optimized for different analysis goals. These modes can be accessed through
the unified \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{visualize\_multilayer\_network}} API or by calling individual plot functions.


\paragraph{Overview of Visualization Modes}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization:overview-of-visualization-modes}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The following visualization modes are available:
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{diagonal} (default): Layer\sphinxhyphen{}centric diagonal layout with inter\sphinxhyphen{}layer edges

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{small\_multiples}: Side\sphinxhyphen{}by\sphinxhyphen{}side comparison of layers in a grid

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{edge\_colored\_projection}: Aggregated view with color\sphinxhyphen{}coded edges by layer

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{supra\_adjacency\_heatmap}: Matrix representation of the multilayer structure

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{radial\_layers}: Concentric circles with layers as rings

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{ego\_multilayer}: Focus on a single node’s neighborhood across layers

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{flow/alluvial}: Layered flow visualization with horizontal bands

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{sankey}: Sankey diagram showing inter\sphinxhyphen{}layer flow strength

\end{enumerate}


\paragraph{Unified API}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization:unified-api}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
All visualization modes can be accessed through the \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{visualize\_multilayer\_network}} function:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{multinet}
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{visualization}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{multilayer}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{visualize\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}network}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Load network}
\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{load\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{network.txt}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{input\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{multiedgelist}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Use any visualization mode}
\PYG{n}{fig} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{visualize\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{visualization\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{small\PYGZus{}multiples}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} or any other mode}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Small Multiples View}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization:small-multiples-view}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Displays each layer as a separate subplot in a grid layout, making it easy to compare
layer structures side\sphinxhyphen{}by\sphinxhyphen{}side.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{visualization}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{multilayer}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{visualize\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}network}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Shared layout (nodes appear at same positions across layers)}
\PYG{n}{fig} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{visualize\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{visualization\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{small\PYGZus{}multiples}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{shared\PYGZus{}layout}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{,}       \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Same node positions in all layers}
    \PYG{n}{layout}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{spring}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}          \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Layout algorithm}
    \PYG{n}{node\PYGZus{}size}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{300}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{max\PYGZus{}cols}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{3}\PYG{p}{,}               \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Maximum columns in grid}
    \PYG{n}{show\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}titles}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{with\PYGZus{}labels}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Independent layouts (optimized per layer)}
\PYG{n}{fig} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{visualize\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{visualization\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{small\PYGZus{}multiples}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{shared\PYGZus{}layout}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{,}      \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Different layouts per layer}
    \PYG{n}{layout}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{circular}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Best for:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Comparing layer structures

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Identifying layer\sphinxhyphen{}specific patterns

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Understanding node presence across layers

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Networks with 2\sphinxhyphen{}10 layers

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Parameters:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{shared\_layout}}: Use same node positions across layers

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{layout}}: “spring”, “circular”, “random”, “kamada\_kawai”

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{max\_cols}}: Maximum number of columns in grid

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{show\_layer\_titles}}: Display layer names

\end{itemize}


\paragraph{Edge\sphinxhyphen{}Colored Projection}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization:edge-colored-projection}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Projects all layers onto a single 2D graph, using edge colors to indicate layer membership.
Useful for seeing the overall structure while maintaining layer information.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{visualization}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{multilayer}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{visualize\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}network}

    \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{visualization\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{edge\PYGZus{}colored\PYGZus{}projection}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{layout}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{spring}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{node\PYGZus{}size}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{500}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{edge\PYGZus{}alpha}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.7}\PYG{p}{,}           \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Edge transparency}
    \PYG{n}{with\PYGZus{}labels}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Custom layer colors}
\PYG{n}{custom\PYGZus{}colors} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}
    \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer1}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{red}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer2}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{blue}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer3}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{green}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}
\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}

\PYG{n}{fig} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{visualize\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{visualization\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{edge\PYGZus{}colored\PYGZus{}projection}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}colors}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{custom\PYGZus{}colors}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\paragraph{Flow and Sankey Diagrams}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization:flow-and-sankey-diagrams}}

Py3plex provides two complementary visualizations for understanding inter\sphinxhyphen{}layer connectivity:
flow/alluvial diagrams and Sankey diagrams. Both show how nodes and connections flow between

by color and size.

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Load network}
\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{load\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{network.txt}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{input\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{multiedgelist}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Flow visualization}
\PYG{n}{ax} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{visualize\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{style}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{flow}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{show}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Or use \PYGZsq{}alluvial\PYGZsq{} (same as \PYGZsq{}flow\PYGZsq{})}
\PYG{n}{ax} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{visualize\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{style}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{alluvial}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{show}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Compare multiple views}
\PYG{n}{modes} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{[}
    \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{small\PYGZus{}multiples}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{edge\PYGZus{}colored\PYGZus{}projection}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{supra\PYGZus{}adjacency\PYGZus{}heatmap}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}

    \PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{close}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{degrees} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n+nb}{dict}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{agg\PYGZus{}graph}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{degree}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}nodes} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n+nb}{sorted}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degrees}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{key}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{degrees}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{reverse}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{]}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Visualize each top node\PYGZsq{}s ego network}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{node} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{fig} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{visualize\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{n}{visualization\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{ego\PYGZus{}multilayer}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}

\paragraph{Choosing the Right Visualization}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/visualization:choosing-the-right-visualization}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use this guide to select the appropriate visualization mode:

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{For structural comparison:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{small\_multiples}} to compare layer structures side\sphinxhyphen{}by\sphinxhyphen{}side

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{edge\_colored\_projection}} to see aggregated structure with layer info

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{For mathematical analysis:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{supra\_adjacency\_heatmap}} for matrix\sphinxhyphen{}based analysis

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Useful for spectral methods and linear algebra operations

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{For temporal or hierarchical networks:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{radial\_layers}} when layers have natural ordering

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Shows progression or hierarchy clearly

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{For local analysis:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{ego\_multilayer}} to understand individual nodes

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Compare how a node’s role varies across layers

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{For presentations:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{edge\_colored\_projection}} for clean, simple overview

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{small\_multiples}} when detail matters

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{radial\_layers}} for visually striking displays

\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{Overview}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/dsl:overview}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Py3plex provides a Domain\sphinxhyphen{}Specific Language (DSL) for querying and analyzing multilayer networks using SQL\sphinxhyphen{}like syntax. This intuitive interface allows users to filter nodes and edges, compute network measures, and perform complex analyses with simple, readable queries.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{DSL v2} introduces several major improvements:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Python Builder API}: Chainable, type\sphinxhyphen{}hinted query construction

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Layer Algebra}: Union, difference, and intersection operations on layers

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Rich Results}: Export to pandas, NetworkX, or Arrow formats

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{EXPLAIN Mode}: Query execution plans with complexity estimates

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Parameterized Queries}: Safe parameter binding for dynamic queries

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Better Errors}: “Did you mean?” suggestions for typos

\end{itemize}

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{note}{Quick Start with Builder API}

\sphinxAtStartPar
For the fastest start, see the comprehensive builder API example:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
python\PYG{+w}{ }examples/network\PYGZus{}analysis/example\PYGZus{}dsl\PYGZus{}builder\PYGZus{}api.py
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
This example demonstrates all DSL v2 features with working code and explanations.
\end{sphinxadmonition}

\sphinxAtStartPar
The DSL enables you to express complex network queries in a natural, SQL\sphinxhyphen{}like language without writing verbose code. For example, instead of manually iterating through nodes and checking conditions, you can write:

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{String DSL syntax:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{execute\PYGZus{}query}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{SELECT nodes WHERE layer=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{social}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{ AND degree \PYGZgt{} 5}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Or using the new Builder API (recommended):}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{L}

\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
The DSL is particularly useful for:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Interactive network exploration}: Quickly test hypotheses and explore network structure

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Rapid prototyping}: Build analysis workflows without extensive coding

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Educational purposes}: Learn network concepts with intuitive queries

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Production pipelines}: Create maintainable, self\sphinxhyphen{}documenting analysis code

\end{itemize}


\subsubsection{Basic Syntax}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/dsl:basic-syntax}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The DSL follows a SQL\sphinxhyphen{}inspired syntax:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{SELECT} \PYG{n}{target} \PYG{n}{WHERE} \PYG{n}{conditions} \PYG{n}{COMPUTE} \PYG{n}{measures}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Where:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{target}: Either \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{nodes}} or \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{edges}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{conditions}: Filtering criteria (optional)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{measures}: Network measures to compute (optional)

\end{itemize}


\subsubsection{DSL Cheat Sheet}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/dsl:dsl-cheat-sheet}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Quick Syntax Reference:}

\subsubsection{Query Components}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/dsl:query-components}}

\paragraph{SELECT Clause}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/dsl:select-clause}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Specifies what to select from the network:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{SELECT} \PYG{n}{nodes}     \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Select nodes}
\PYG{n}{SELECT} \PYG{n}{edges}     \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Select edges (edge queries in development)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Note}: Current version primarily supports node queries.


\paragraph{WHERE Clause}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/dsl:where-clause}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Filters results based on conditions. Supports:

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Layer filtering}:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{WHERE} \PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{transport}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}
\PYG{n}{WHERE} \PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Degree filtering}:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{WHERE} \PYG{n}{degree} \PYG{o}{\PYGZgt{}} \PYG{l+m+mi}{5}
\PYG{n}{WHERE} \PYG{n}{degree} \PYG{o}{\PYGZgt{}}\PYG{o}{=} \PYG{l+m+mi}{3}
\PYG{n}{WHERE} \PYG{n}{degree} \PYG{o}{\PYGZlt{}}\PYG{o}{=} \PYG{l+m+mi}{10}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Logical operators}:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{WHERE} \PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}} \PYG{n}{AND} \PYG{n}{degree} \PYG{o}{\PYGZgt{}} \PYG{l+m+mi}{3}
\PYG{n}{WHERE} \PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{work}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}} \PYG{n}{OR} \PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}
\PYG{n}{WHERE} \PYG{n}{NOT} \PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{transport}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Comparison operators}:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{=}} : Equal to

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{!=}} : Not equal to

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textgreater{}}} : Greater than

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textless{}}} : Less than

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textgreater{}=}} : Greater than or equal

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textless{}=}} : Less than or equal

\end{itemize}


\paragraph{COMPUTE Clause}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/dsl:compute-clause}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Calculates network measures for filtered nodes:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{COMPUTE} \PYG{n}{degree}
\PYG{n}{COMPUTE} \PYG{n}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}
\PYG{n}{COMPUTE} \PYG{n}{closeness\PYGZus{}centrality}
\PYG{n}{COMPUTE} \PYG{n}{eigenvector\PYGZus{}centrality}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Supported measures}:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{degree}} \sphinxhyphen{} Node degree

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{degree\_centrality}} \sphinxhyphen{} Normalized degree centrality

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{betweenness\_centrality}} \sphinxhyphen{} Betweenness centrality

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{closeness\_centrality}} \sphinxhyphen{} Closeness centrality

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{eigenvector\_centrality}} \sphinxhyphen{} Eigenvector centrality

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{pagerank}} \sphinxhyphen{} PageRank score

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{clustering}} \sphinxhyphen{} Clustering coefficient

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Multiple measures}:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]

\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\subsubsection{Python Builder API (DSL v2)}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/dsl:python-builder-api-dsl-v2}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
DSL v2 introduces a Pythonic builder API that provides type hints, autocompletion,
and a chainable interface for constructing queries. The builder API maps directly
to the DSL syntax but with Python\sphinxhyphen{}native ergonomics.


\paragraph{Basic Usage}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/dsl:basic-usage}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Import the builder components:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{Param}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Create and execute a simple query:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Select nodes in the social layer}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get the count}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Found }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{count}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{ nodes}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Iterate over results}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{node} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{node}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Query Builder Methods}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/dsl:query-builder-methods}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{Q}} class provides factory methods to start building queries:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{Q.nodes()}} \sphinxhyphen{} Start a query for nodes

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{Q.edges()}} \sphinxhyphen{} Start a query for edges

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
The \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{QueryBuilder}} returned supports these chainable methods:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
 \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}expr}\PYG{p}{)}    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Filter by layers (optional)}
 \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{o}{*}\PYG{o}{*}\PYG{n}{conditions}\PYG{p}{)}        \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Filter by conditions (optional)}
 \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{o}{*}\PYG{n}{measures}\PYG{p}{)}         \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Compute measures (optional)}
 \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{o}{*}\PYG{n}{keys}\PYG{p}{)}            \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Order results (optional)}
 \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{limit}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{n}\PYG{p}{)}                   \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Limit results (optional)}
 \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{o}{*}\PYG{o}{*}\PYG{n}{params}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Execute the query}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{WHERE Conditions}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/dsl:where-conditions}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{where()}} method supports Django\sphinxhyphen{}style field lookups:

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Equality}:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Comparisons} (using double\sphinxhyphen{}underscore suffixes):

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)}      \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} degree \PYGZgt{} 5}
\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gte}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)}     \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} degree \PYGZgt{}= 5}
\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}lt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}     \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} degree \PYGZlt{} 10}
\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}lte}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} degree \PYGZlt{}= 10}
\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}ne}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{bots}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} layer != \PYGZdq{}bots\PYGZdq{}}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Multiple conditions} (combined with AND):

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Special predicates}:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{intralayer}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{)}                    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Edges within same layer}
\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{interlayer}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{work}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}     \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Edges between specific layers}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{COMPUTE with Aliases}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/dsl:compute-with-aliases}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Compute network measures with optional aliases:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Single measure}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Single measure with alias}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{alias}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{bc}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Multiple measures}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{clustering}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Multiple measures with aliases}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{aliases}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}
    \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{bc}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{closeness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{cc}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}
\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{ORDER BY and LIMIT}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/dsl:order-by-and-limit}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Sort and limit results:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Order by degree (ascending)}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Order descending with \PYGZhy{} prefix}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZhy{}degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}

\paragraph{Layer Algebra}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/dsl:layer-algebra}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
DSL v2 introduces layer algebra for combining multiple layers. Use the \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{L}} proxy
to reference layers and combine them with operators:

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Union} (+): Nodes from either layer:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]

\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{layers}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Difference} (\sphinxhyphen{}): Nodes from one layer but not another:

\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{layers}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar

\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{layers}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{layers} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{+} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{work}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{bots}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}

\paragraph{Complete Builder Example}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/dsl:complete-builder-example}}

Here’s a comprehensive example using the builder API:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{multinet}

\paragraph{QueryResult Object}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/dsl:queryresult-object}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The builder API returns a \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{QueryResult}} object with rich export capabilities:

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Properties}:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{target}    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} \PYGZsq{}nodes\PYGZsq{} or \PYGZsq{}edges\PYGZsq{}}
\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{items}     \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} List of node/edge tuples}
\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{count}     \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Number of items}
\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}     \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Alias for items (when target=\PYGZsq{}nodes\PYGZsq{})}
\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{edges}     \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Alias for items (when target=\PYGZsq{}edges\PYGZsq{})}
\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{attributes}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Computed measure values}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Export methods}:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Export to pandas DataFrame}
\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Export to NetworkX subgraph}
\PYG{n}{G} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}networkx}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Export to Apache Arrow table}
\PYG{n}{table} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}arrow}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Export to dictionary}
\PYG{n}{d} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}dict}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Iteration}:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{node} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{node}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Length}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Declarative File Exports}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/dsl:declarative-file-exports}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
DSL v2 supports declarative file exports, allowing you to export query results
to files as part of the query pipeline itself. The export is a side\sphinxhyphen{}effect \sphinxhyphen{}
the query still returns a \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{QueryResult}} object to Python.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Basic CSV Export}:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{L}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Export to CSV file}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{export\PYGZus{}csv}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{results/social\PYGZus{}degree.csv}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Result is still available in Python}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Exported }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{count}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{ nodes}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{JSON Export with Options}:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Export to JSON with custom format}

    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{desc}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{limit}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{export\PYGZus{}json}\PYG{p}{(}
         \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{results/top\PYGZus{}nodes.json}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
         \PYG{n}{columns}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{id}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
         \PYG{n}{orient}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{records}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}
     \PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Generic Export Method}:

         \PYG{n}{fmt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{csv}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Supported Export Formats:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Export Options:}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleemphasis{CSV/TSV Options:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar

\sphinxAtStartPar

\begin{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar

\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{clustering}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{export\PYGZus{}csv}\PYG{p}{(}
         \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{results/selected.csv}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
         \PYG{n}{columns}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{id}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Only export ID and degree}
     \PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}

\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Complete Export Example}:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{multinet}
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{L}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create network}
\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{directed}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} ... add nodes and edges ...}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Export social layer analysis to CSV}
\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{desc}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{export\PYGZus{}csv}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{results/social\PYGZus{}analysis.csv}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Export work layer analysis to JSON}
\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{work}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{export\PYGZus{}json}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{results/work\PYGZus{}analysis.json}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{orient}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{records}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Export combined analysis with custom delimiter}
\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{export\PYGZus{}csv}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{results/all\PYGZus{}nodes.tsv}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{delimiter}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+se}{\PYGZbs{}t}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}
